items.title: Birational classification of orbifold compactified Jacobians and tori by minimal generalized tropical compactifications
items.author: Jeremy Feusi; Sam Molcho
items.difficulty_reason: The orbifold birational classification requires log compactification and log alteration categories, Artin fans and tropical descent, representable subdivisions versus birational maps, existence/uniqueness of generalized minimal compactifications and logarithmic Jacobian Neron mapping properties. Original log smooth base and Jacobian-or-torus assumptions retained with the full categorical diagram and construction/proof chain. This is an independent global classification beyond the old local fan criterion.

primary.label: complete original main classification theorem and native categorical diagram

proof_spans.label: full author Artin-fan/log alteration correspondence, tropical descent, combinatorial minimality, geometric translation, Jacobian Neron mapping and toric/Jacobian classification proofs with all native figures

contexts.label: complete original orbifold birational-equivalence, log compactification and tropical/minimal-object setting
